description: PB-38 is the Regional Transport Office for the Patti subdivision within the Tarn Taran district of Punjab. The office operates under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) and manages vehicle registration, road tax collection, and the issuance of driving licenses for the Patti tehsil.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Magistrate (SDM), Patti, District Tarn Taran, Punjab
